notes: Added missing operational hardening stories: audit logging, config-driven allowlist, error handling, and performance guards.

change_log.value: Add audit logging for enforcement decisions
Enforce query cost and size limits

stories.title: Audit Logging for Enforcement Decisions
stories.description: Implement structured audit logs capturing each GPTReader request, validation outcome (allowed/blocked), violated rule (if any), and metadata for security review and SIT traceability.

stories.title: Config-Driven Allowlist Definition
stories.description: Move allowlist rules (collections, fields, operators, limits) to a centralized configuration module with strict loading and validation to avoid hardcoded enforcement logic.

stories.title: Standardized Error and Rejection Responses
stories.description: Define and enforce a consistent response contract for rejected requests, including error codes, safe messaging, and no leakage of internal schema or enforcement logic.

stories.title: Query Cost and Size Guardrails
stories.description: Enforce strict limits on query size, document count, and execution cost (e.g., max 100 docs, payload size caps) before execution to prevent abuse and align with existing GPTReader constraints.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (100-doc limit, 500KB cap); Code/DataPipelines/tests/test_gpt_reader.py; RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-001
